description: Atlas evidence: call with no arguments. The signed brief covers the whole board in the published dataset version read: the asset count, the assets and rights counts per stage, and disclosed against not disclosed across the six rights fields, per field and in total, beside the catalog rights coverage the dataset publishes. POST /api/atlas-market-brief. Reads the published Tokenization Atlas dataset at https://atlas.weverlabs.com/api/assets once per call, the same read the Atlas evidence tools make, with no dataset writes and no issuer contact. Every report names the dataset version it read, and a field the dataset does not hold is reported as not in the published dataset. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/atlas-board-contract. Human page: https://atlas.weverlabs.com/.

inputSchema.description: No arguments. Send {} or omit the arguments.
